summary: Validated Clerk configuration, unauthenticated API protection, signed-out redirects, and mobile sign-in rendering. Authenticated dashboard and CRUD flows could not be exercised because test_credentials.md contains no test user.

ui_bugs.issue: Projects renders Listing with type=projects, but Listing labels every non-reports page as Issues & risks and uses the issue wording/icon/status presentation.
New reports/issues buttons have no onClick handler and do not open a creation form.

action_items: Fix Listing/projects rendering so /projects has project-specific title, copy, symbols, and record semantics.
Wire New site report and New issue actions on their listing routes or remove the inactive controls.
Add a real Clerk test account and record it in /app/memory/test_credentials.md for authenticated regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Listing type handling treats every type other than reports as issues, making the Projects navigation materially misleading.
Listing create buttons are interactive-looking controls without handlers, so core report/issue creation is unavailable outside the dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clerk email card rendered at /sign-in; root and /projects redirect correctly while signed out; mobile 390px had no horizontal overflow. No credentials are available, so dashboard, modals, CSV export, authenticated routes, and persistence remain unverified.
rca of the issue: The Projects bug is caused by Listing's conditional logic: it only special-cases type === 'reports', so type === 'projects' falls through to the issues copy and presentation. The inactive listing actions are bare buttons in Listing with no event handler or modal state.
